address: 136G Tran Vu Street, Truc Bach Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, 100000, Vietnam
bio: With a rustic, vintage ambience inspired by the subsidy period and the owner's antique collection from the last 50 years, Mậu Dịch Số 37 offers a nostalgic experience. Signature dishes include Hanoi spring rolls, fried hemibagrus fish and scorched rice with beef stew (cơm chay bò cay). The crispy rice cracker, made à la minute, and grilled shrimp are recommended....
